cond_0001.intro:
The Department of Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences at [Company name masked] is seeking a Research Data Analyst (RDA 1) to manage and analyze large amounts of multi-modality brain imaging data under the direction of Dr. Vankee Lin. CogT Lab focuses on the evaluation of various cognitive interventions among older adults and understanding the underlying neural mechanisms. For more information on the lab, please visit: https://www.cogtlab.com/
Interested candidates should include a cover letter along with their CV.
cond_0001.responsibilities: Manage and clean datasets. Employ new and existing tools to interpret, analyze, and visualize multivariate relationships in data. Create databases and reports, develop algorithms and statistical and/or computational models, and perform data analyses appropriate to data and reporting requirements. Use system reports and analyses to identify potentially problematic data, make corrections, and determine root cause for data problems from input errors or inadequate field edits, and suggest possible solutions. Develop reports, charts, graphs and tables for use by investigators and for publication and presentation. Analyze data processes in documentation. Collaborate with faculty and research staff on data collection and analysis methods. Provide documentation based on audit and reporting criteria to investigators and research staff. Communicate with government officials, grant agencies and industry representatives. Other duties may also be assigned.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in computational and engineering sciences (e.g., computer science, computational biology, electrical engineering, biomedical engineering) or other related fields, or a combination of education and relevant experience.
Experience with signal processing of medical imaging data.
Experience with or demonstrated interest in neuroimaging techniques.
Experience with Neuroimaging (FSL, SPM, AFNI, or equivalent) software.
Experience using high-performance computer clusters and bash/shell scripting.
Experience in data science, statistics, optimization, machine learning, and/or deep learning.
Strong writing and analytical skills in machine learning.
Ability to prioritize workload.
Preferred Requirements
Experience with machine learning frameworks (e.g. PyTorch, Tensorflow, etc.).
Experience with statistical software (R, SAS, SPSS, or equivalent), and other common programming languages in neuroimaging (Python, MATLAB).
Prior experience with R is highly recommended for data analysis.
Experience in a quantitative discipline such as economics, finance, statistics or engineering.
Substantial experience with MS Office and analytical programs.

cond_0072.intro:
The Department of Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences at [Company name masked] is looking for a Research Data Analyst (RDA 1) to help manage and analyze large amounts of multi-modality brain imaging data. The lab focuses on evaluating cognitive interventions among older adults and understanding the underlying neural mechanisms.
Interested candidates should include a cover letter along with their CV.
cond_0072.responsibilities: Manage and clean datasets in coordination with the research team. Work with existing and new tools to interpret, analyze, and visualize multivariate relationships in data. Collaborate with faculty and research staff to create databases and reports, develop algorithms and statistical and/or computational models, and carry out data analyses appropriate to data and reporting requirements. Help identify potentially problematic data using system reports and analyses, support corrections, and work with the team to determine root causes of data problems from input errors or inadequate field edits, and suggest possible solutions. Contribute to the development of reports, charts, graphs, and tables for use by investigators and for publication and presentation. Support documentation of data processes. Work alongside faculty and research staff on data collection and analysis methods. Provide documentation based on audit and reporting criteria to investigators and research staff. Coordinate with government officials, grant agencies, and industry representatives. Other duties may also be assigned.
cond_0072.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in computational and engineering sciences (e.g., computer science, computational biology, electrical engineering, biomedical engineering) or other related fields.
Experience with signal processing of medical imaging data.
Experience with or demonstrated interest in neuroimaging techniques.
Experience with Neuroimaging (FSL, SPM, AFNI, or equivalent) software.
Experience using high-performance computer clusters and bash/shell scripting.
Experience in data science, statistics, optimization, machine learning, and/or deep learning.
Experience with machine learning frameworks (e.g. PyTorch, Tensorflow, etc.)
Experience with Statistical software (R, SAS, SPSS, or equivalent), and other common programming languages in neuroimaging (python, MATLAB).
Prior experience with R is highly recommended for data analysis.
Bachelor's degree or a combination of education and relevant experience.
Experience in a quantitative discipline such as economics, finance, statistics or engineering.
Substantial experience with MS Office and analytical programs.
Strong writing and analytical skills in machine learning.
Ability to prioritize workload.
PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:
Sitting in place at computer for long periods of time with extensive keyboarding/dexterity. Occasionally use a telephone. Rarely writing by hand. CogT Lab focuses on evaluating cognitive interventions among older adults and understanding the underlying neural mechanisms. For more information on the lab, please visit: https://www.cogtlab.com/
Interested candidates should include a cover letter along with their CV.
cond_0116.responsibilities: Manage and clean datasets. Drive the use of new and existing tools to interpret, analyze, and visualize multivariate relationships in data. Build databases and reports, develop algorithms and statistical and/or computational models, and execute data analyses appropriate to data and reporting requirements. Use system reports and analyses to identify potentially problematic data, make corrections, and determine root cause for data problems from input errors or inadequate field edits, and propose solutions. Develop reports, charts, graphs and tables for use by investigators and for publication and presentation. Analyze data processes in documentation. Lead collaboration with faculty and research staff on data collection and analysis methods. Deliver documentation based on audit and reporting criteria to investigators and research staff. Communicate with government officials, grant agencies and industry representatives. Other duties may also be assigned.
cond_0116.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in computational and engineering sciences (e.g., computer science, computational biology, electrical engineering, biomedical engineering) or other related fields, or a combination of education and relevant experience.
Experience in a quantitative discipline such as economics, finance, statistics, or engineering.
Experience with signal processing of medical imaging data.
Experience using high-performance computer clusters and bash/shell scripting.
Experience in data science, statistics, optimization, machine learning, and/or deep learning.
Strong writing and analytical skills in machine learning.
Substantial experience with MS Office and analytical programs.
Ability to prioritize workload.
Preferred Requirements
Experience with or demonstrated interest in neuroimaging techniques.
Experience with Neuroimaging (FSL, SPM, AFNI, or equivalent) software.
Experience with machine learning frameworks (e.g. PyTorch, Tensorflow, etc.).
Experience with Statistical software (R, SAS, SPSS, or equivalent), and other common programming languages in neuroimaging (Python, MATLAB).
Prior experience with R is highly recommended for data analysis.
PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:
Sitting in place at computer for long periods of time with extensive keyboarding/dexterity. Occasionally use a telephone. Rarely writing by hand. Consistent with its obligations under the law, [Company name masked] will provide reasonable accommodation to any employee with a disability who requires accommodation to perform the essential functions of his or her job.

cond_0181.intro:
The Department of Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences at [Company name masked] is seeking a Research Data Analyst (RDA 1) to manage and analyze large amounts of multi-modality brain imaging data under the direction of Dr. Vankee Lin. CogT Lab focuses on the evaluation of various cognitive interventions among older adults and understanding the underlying neural mechanisms. For more information on the lab, please visit: https://www.cogtlab.com/
Interested candidates should include a cover letter along with their CV.
cond_0181.responsibilities: Manage and clean datasets. Employ new and existing tools to interpret, analyze, and visualize multivariate relationships in data. Create databases and reports, develop algorithms and statistical and/or computational models, and perform data analyses appropriate to data and reporting requirements. Use system reports and analyses to identify potentially problematic data, make corrections, and determine root cause for data problems from input errors or inadequate field edits, and suggest possible solutions. Develop reports, charts, graphs and tables for use by investigators and for publication and presentation. Analyze data processes in documentation. Collaborate with faculty and research staff on data collection and analysis methods. Provide documentation based on audit and reporting criteria to investigators and research staff. cond_0181.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in computational and engineering sciences (e.g., computer science, computational biology, electrical engineering, biomedical engineering) or other related fields, or a combination of education and relevant experience.
Experience with signal processing of medical imaging data.
Experience with or demonstrated interest in neuroimaging techniques.
Experience with Neuroimaging (FSL, SPM, AFNI, or equivalent) software.
Experience using high-performance computer clusters and bash/shell scripting.
Experience in data science, statistics, optimization, machine learning, and/or deep learning.
Strong writing and analytical skills in machine learning.
Ability to prioritize workload.
Preferred Requirements
Experience with machine learning frameworks (e.g. PyTorch, Tensorflow, etc.).
Experience with statistical software (R, SAS, SPSS, or equivalent), and other common programming languages in neuroimaging (Python, MATLAB).
Prior experience with R is highly recommended for data analysis.
Experience in a quantitative discipline such as economics, finance, statistics or engineering.
Substantial experience with MS Office and analytical programs.

CogT Lab focuses on the evaluation of various cognitive interventions among older adults and understanding the underlying neural mechanisms. For more information on the lab, please visit: https://www.cogtlab.com/
Interested candidates should include a cover letter along with their CV.
People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of neuroimaging data and how different analysis methods apply to it.
cond_0247.responsibilities: Manage and clean datasets. Employ new and existing tools to interpret, analyze, and visualize multivariate relationships in data. Create databases and reports, develop algorithms and statistical and/or computational models, and perform data analyses appropriate to data and reporting requirements. Use system reports and analyses to identify potentially problematic data, make corrections, and determine root cause for data problems from input errors or inadequate field edits, and suggest possible solutions. Develop reports, charts, graphs and tables for use by investigators and for publication and presentation. Analyze data processes in documentation. Collaborate with faculty and research staff on data collection and analysis methods. Provide documentation based on audit and reporting criteria to investigators and research staff. Communicate with government officials, grant agencies and industry representatives. Other duties may also be assigned.
cond_0247.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in computational and engineering sciences (e.g., computer science, computational biology, electrical engineering, biomedical engineering) or other related fields.
Experience with signal processing of medical imaging data.
Experience with or demonstrated interest in neuroimaging techniques.
Experience with Neuroimaging (FSL, SPM, AFNI, or equivalent) software.
Experience using high-performance computer clusters and bash/shell scripting.
Experience in data science, statistics, optimization, machine learning, and/or deep learning.
Experience with machine learning frameworks (e.g. PyTorch, Tensorflow, etc.)
Experience with Statistical software (R, SAS, SPSS, or equivalent), and other common programming languages in neuroimaging (python, MATLAB).
Prior experience with R is highly recommended for data analysis.
Bachelor's degree or a combination of education and relevant experience.
Experience in a quantitative discipline such as economics, finance, statistics or engineering.
Substantial experience with MS Office and analytical programs.
Strong writing and analytical skills in machine learning.
Ability to prioritize workload.
PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:
Sitting in place at computer for long periods of time with extensive keyboarding/dexterity. Occasionally use a telephone. Rarely writing by hand. Consistent with its obligations under the law, the University will provide reasonable accommodation to any employee with a disability who requires accommodation to perform the essential functions of his or her job.

cond_0299.intro: We are looking for a Research Data Analyst to join our team.
cond_0299.responsibilities:
Duties Include
Manage and clean datasets. Employ new and existing tools to interpret, analyze, and visualize multivariate relationships in data. Create databases and reports, develop algorithms and statistical and/or computational models, and perform data analyses appropriate to data and reporting requirements. Use system reports and analyses to identify potentially problematic data, make corrections, and determine root cause for data problems from input errors or inadequate field edits, and suggest possible solutions. Develop reports, charts, graphs and tables for use by investigators and for publication and presentation. Analyze data processes in documentation. Collaborate with faculty and research staff on data collection and analysis methods. Provide documentation based on audit and reporting criteria to investigators and research staff. Communicate with government officials, grant agencies and industry representatives. Other duties may also be assigned.
cond_0299.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in computational and engineering sciences (e.g., computer science, computational biology, electrical engineering, biomedical engineering) or other related fields required; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Demonstrated expertise in signal processing of medical imaging data.
Proven proficiency in neuroimaging techniques.
Deep knowledge of Neuroimaging (FSL, SPM, AFNI, or equivalent) software.
Strong command of high-performance computer clusters and bash/shell scripting.
Substantial expertise in data science, statistics, optimization, machine learning, and/or deep learning.
Advanced knowledge of machine learning frameworks (e.g. PyTorch, Tensorflow, etc.).
Strong command of statistical software (R, SAS, SPSS, or equivalent), and other common programming languages in neuroimaging (Python, MATLAB). Extensive experience with R is highly recommended for data analysis.
Bachelor's degree or a combination of education and relevant experience in a quantitative discipline such as economics, finance, statistics, or engineering.
Extensive experience with MS Office and analytical programs.
Exceptional writing and analytical skills in machine learning.
Ability to prioritize workload.
PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:
Sitting in place at computer for long periods of time with extensive keyboarding/dexterity. Occasionally use a telephone. Rarely writing by hand. cond_0354.intro: We are looking for a Research Data Analyst to join our team.
cond_0354.responsibilities:
Duties Include
Manage and clean datasets. Employ new and existing tools to interpret, analyze, and visualize multivariate relationships in data. Create databases and reports, develop algorithms and statistical and/or computational models, and perform data analyses appropriate to data and reporting requirements. Use system reports and analyses to identify potentially problematic data, make corrections, and determine root cause for data problems from input errors or inadequate field edits, and suggest possible solutions. Develop reports, charts, graphs and tables for use by investigators and for publication and presentation. Analyze data processes in documentation. Collaborate with faculty and research staff on data collection and analysis methods. Provide documentation based on audit and reporting criteria to investigators and research staff. Communicate with government officials, grant agencies and industry representatives. Other duties may also be assigned.
cond_0354.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in computational and engineering sciences (e.g., computer science, computational biology, electrical engineering, biomedical engineering) or other related fields, or equivalent practical experience.
Some experience with signal processing of medical imaging data, or a willingness to build that knowledge on the job.
Exposure to or demonstrated interest in neuroimaging techniques.
Familiarity with neuroimaging software (FSL, SPM, AFNI, or equivalent).
Some experience using high-performance computer clusters and bash/shell scripting, or comfort learning these tools.
Background in data science, statistics, optimization, machine learning, and/or deep learning.
Working knowledge of machine learning frameworks (e.g. PyTorch, TensorFlow, etc.).
Familiarity with statistical software (R, SAS, SPSS, or equivalent) and common programming languages used in neuroimaging (Python, MATLAB).
Experience with R is helpful for data analysis, though not strictly required.
Bachelor's degree or a combination of education and relevant experience.
Background in a quantitative discipline such as economics, finance, statistics, or engineering.
Working knowledge of MS Office and analytical programs.
Ability to communicate findings clearly in writing; openness to developing analytical skills in machine learning.
Ability to prioritize workload.
PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:
Sitting in place at computer for long periods of time with extensive keyboarding/dexterity. Occasionally use a telephone. Rarely writing by hand. CogT Lab focuses on the evaluation of various cognitive interventions among older adults and understanding the underlying neural mechanisms. For more information on the lab, please visit: https://www.cogtlab.com/
Interested candidates should include a cover letter along with their CV.
cond_0398.responsibilities:
Duties Include
Manage and clean datasets. Employ new and existing tools to interpret, analyze, and visualize multivariate relationships in data. Create databases and reports, develop algorithms and statistical and/or computational models, and perform data analyses appropriate to data and reporting requirements. Use system reports and analyses to identify potentially problematic data, make corrections, and determine root cause for data problems from input errors or inadequate field edits, and suggest possible solutions. Develop reports, charts, graphs and tables for use by investigators and for publication and presentation. Analyze data processes in documentation. Collaborate with faculty and research staff on data collection and analysis methods. Provide documentation based on audit and reporting criteria to investigators and research staff. Communicate with government officials, grant agencies and industry representatives. Other duties may also be assigned.
cond_0398.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in computational and engineering sciences (e.g., computer science, computational biology, electrical engineering, biomedical engineering) or other related fields; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Demonstrated expertise in signal processing of medical imaging data.
Deep knowledge of neuroimaging techniques and proven track record using neuroimaging software (FSL, SPM, AFNI, or equivalent).
Strong command of high-performance computer clusters and bash/shell scripting.
Extensive experience in data science, statistics, optimization, machine learning, and/or deep learning.
Expertise in machine learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, etc.).
Advanced knowledge of statistical software (R, SAS, SPSS, or equivalent) and common neuroimaging programming languages (Python, MATLAB).
Preferred Requirements
Substantial proficiency with R for data analysis.
Background in a quantitative discipline such as economics, finance, statistics, or engineering.
Exceptional writing and analytical skills in machine learning.
Strong command of MS Office and analytical programs.
Proven ability to manage and prioritize a complex workload independently.
PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:
Sitting in place at computer for long periods of time with extensive keyboarding/dexterity. Occasionally use a telephone. Rarely writing by hand. Consistent with its obligations under the law, the University will provide reasonable accommodation to any employee with a disability who requires accommodation to perform the essential functions of his or her job.
cond_0398.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0398.values: We value strong results, high standards, and the pursuit of excellent work. We believe organizations perform best when they are guided by ambition and quality.

cond_0487.intro:
The Department of Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences at [Company name masked] is seeking a Research Data Analyst (RDA 1) to manage and analyze large amounts of multi-modality brain imaging data under the direction of Dr. Vankee Lin. CogT Lab focuses on the evaluation of various cognitive interventions among older adults and understanding the underlying neural mechanisms. For more information on the lab, please visit: https://www.cogtlab.com/
Interested candidates should include a cover letter along with their CV.
cond_0487.responsibilities: Manage and clean datasets. Employ new and existing tools to interpret, analyze, and visualize multivariate relationships in data. Create databases and reports, develop algorithms and statistical and/or computational models, and perform data analyses appropriate to data and reporting requirements. Use system reports and analyses to identify potentially problematic data, make corrections, and determine root cause for data problems from input errors or inadequate field edits, and suggest possible solutions. Develop reports, charts, graphs and tables for use by investigators and for publication and presentation. Analyze data processes in documentation. Collaborate with faculty and research staff on data collection and analysis methods. Provide documentation based on audit and reporting criteria to investigators and research staff. Communicate with government officials, grant agencies and industry representatives. Other duties may also be assigned.
cond_0487.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in computational and engineering sciences (e.g., computer science, computational biology, electrical engineering, biomedical engineering) or other related fields, or a combination of education and relevant experience.
Experience with signal processing of medical imaging data.
Experience with or demonstrated interest in neuroimaging techniques.
Experience with Neuroimaging (FSL, SPM, AFNI, or equivalent) software.
Experience using high-performance computer clusters and bash/shell scripting.
Experience in data science, statistics, optimization, machine learning, and/or deep learning.
Strong writing and analytical skills in machine learning.
Ability to prioritize workload.
Preferred Requirements
Experience with machine learning frameworks (e.g. PyTorch, Tensorflow, etc.).
Experience with statistical software (R, SAS, SPSS, or equivalent), and other common programming languages in neuroimaging (Python, MATLAB).
Prior experience with R is highly recommended for data analysis.
Experience in a quantitative discipline such as economics, finance, statistics or engineering.
Substantial experience with MS Office and analytical programs.

CogT Lab focuses on the evaluation of various cognitive interventions among older adults and understanding the underlying neural mechanisms. For more information on the lab, please visit: https://www.cogtlab.com/
Interested candidates should include a cover letter along with their CV.
People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with neuroimaging data and analysis methods.
cond_0590.responsibilities: Manage and clean datasets. Employ new and existing tools to interpret, analyze, and visualize multivariate relationships in data. Create databases and reports, develop algorithms and statistical and/or computational models, and perform data analyses appropriate to data and reporting requirements. Use system reports and analyses to identify potentially problematic data, make corrections, and determine root cause for data problems from input errors or inadequate field edits, and suggest possible solutions. Develop reports, charts, graphs and tables for use by investigators and for publication and presentation. Analyze data processes in documentation. Collaborate with faculty and research staff on data collection and analysis methods. Provide documentation based on audit and reporting criteria to investigators and research staff. Communicate with government officials, grant agencies and industry representatives. Other duties may also be assigned.
cond_0590.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in computational and engineering sciences (e.g., computer science, computational biology, electrical engineering, biomedical engineering) or other related fields.
Experience with signal processing of medical imaging data.
Experience with or demonstrated interest in neuroimaging techniques.
Experience with Neuroimaging (FSL, SPM, AFNI, or equivalent) software.
Experience using high-performance computer clusters and bash/shell scripting.
Experience in data science, statistics, optimization, machine learning, and/or deep learning.
Experience with machine learning frameworks (e.g. PyTorch, Tensorflow, etc.)
Experience with Statistical software (R, SAS, SPSS, or equivalent), and other common programming languages in neuroimaging (python, MATLAB).
Prior experience with R is highly recommended for data analysis.
Bachelor's degree or a combination of education and relevant experience.
Experience in a quantitative discipline such as economics, finance, statistics or engineering.
Substantial experience with MS Office and analytical programs.
Strong writing and analytical skills in machine learning.
Ability to prioritize workload.
PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:
Sitting in place at computer for long periods of time with extensive keyboarding/dexterity. Occasionally use a telephone. Rarely writing by hand. Consistent with its obligations under the law, the University will provide reasonable accommodation to any employee with a disability who requires accommodation to perform the essential functions of his or her job.
